A portfolio adaptation by Princewill Okube using the user-supplied Minecraft Web Client source archive. The underlying engine is the MIT-licensed Minecraft Web Client project by PrismarineJS and its contributors; this is not an engine built from scratch by Princewill.

What was adapted

  • Voxel Trails branding, an illustrated portfolio cover and a new loading identity.
  • A world-first menu with quick access to singleplayer, imported worlds, the game collection and these build notes.
  • Portfolio-specific configuration, welcome text, explorer usernames and game-library integration.
  • The upstream rendering, world generation, inventory, crafting, controls and browser world-saving code are preserved.

Start building

Choose Create / explore a world, create a new singleplayer world, then follow the in-game controls. WASD moves, the mouse looks, Space jumps, E opens inventory and Escape opens the menu. Import a local world from the folder button. Features and world-format support depend on the upstream client. Multiplayer requires a compatible server/proxy and is not hosted by this portfolio.

Keep browser storage enabled to retain local worlds. Export important worlds before clearing site data.
